author: Carlos_C

title: Extremely beautiful views. Serene ride! Very safe.
text: We had so much fun on this beautiful balloon ride. Everyone involved was so kind and helpful. Getting to the site was very easy from Barcelona with a ride from Andres! The views from the balloon were unmatched. My favorite was seeing a unique perspective of Montserrat mountain… just gorgeous!!
author: D7101ILgabriellem

title: Worth every penny
text:
Perfect from beginning to end.  Booking was easy.  Being picked up and dropped off at our hotel (thank you Andres) was well worth the up charge.  Jordi our pilot was personable, professional and highly skilled.  The lift off was amazing as you didn't even realize it was happening until you were several feet off the ground.  The flight was peaceful and serene with vistas ranging from Montserrat to a salt mine to bucolic villages dotting the landscapes.

author: wmccfp

title: Barcelona Balloon Flights ... A truly magical experience.
text: David, one of the crew members, picked us up at our hotel and we drove into the Catalonian countryside. When we arrived at the first launch site it was fogged in. So we drove five miles northeast to a small town called Llivia where the conditions were perfect. The crew set up the balloon and soon we were off. It was so quiet and the views were spectacular. The pilot maneuvered the balloon in a 360 degree pattern so everyone could get a view of the area. author: MrEd-60

title: Great experience - a must do in Barcelona
text: We had a great flight with Barcelona Balloon Flights at Igualada. The online booking was easy, great communication and info received was clear. From the point of our hotel pickup in Barcelona city to the launch field the team he did everything to ensure the experience was enjoyable. With a friendly welcome and being very knowledgable, our pilot Nico was able to answer all of our questions and was a pleasure to fly with! Hope to fly with you again 😃
author: NS85

title: 10/10 Hot Air Balloon Experience!
text: Can not recommend Fernando and his team enough! The pick up was easy and centrally located, they provided coffee and croissants upon arrival, and then we were off! The views were spectacular and the ride was so smooth. Fernando was very knowledgeable about the area, the history of hot air balloons, etc. He and team took many photos and videos for us. Upon landing we had a small picnic in a field with champagne, strawberries, and cured meats. Then we were driven back to our meeting point. I would fly in Fernando's hot air balloon every day if i could!!
author: Camper31589697442

title: Couldn't have been any better!
text:
From start to finish the whole process was perfect!  I planned this from afar for a group of 9 and it couldn't have gone any smoother or better!  

The guests had an amazing, memorable time, Fernando was amazing to work with, and the breakfast addition was perfect way to end the excursion.  The pictures we received as well were such a nice touch!

I HIGHLY recommend this group and tour!
author: wdiedericks

title: A great experience
text: Very good communications, punctual door to door pick up from hotel to site. Our pilot Fernando was professional, fun and skilful and it was an extremely smooth and wonderful flight. Was a truly memorable experience !
author: Adelin_C

title: Amazing customer service
text: In fact, I was actually unable to fly due to unforeseen circumstances. That said, Fernando and his team made every effort to reschedule during my short time in Barcelona. The professionalism he and his team displayed was amazing particularly during this time when help is so difficult to find. I applaud the quality of their service and will definitely reschedule with them. Class act.
author: V7664ZOpatrickd

title: Breathe Taking Views
text: This Hot Air Ballon Flight was the highlight of my Trip. The views were amazing, the weather was great and our Pilot John made this experience very enjoyable, we conversed and he made the journey calming. After our flight, we had a nice elegant wine and snack setup.
